cards.hint: Focus on microbes living without sunlight at vents
cards.quote: Chemosynthesis: The process by which microbes create sugars (food) using energy released from chemical reactions.
cards.stem: Which process lets deep sea microbes make sugars using energy from chemical reactions

cards.hint: Think of green plants using sun power for food
cards.quote: Photosynthesis: The process used by plants to convert carbon dioxide and water into oxygen and sugars (food), using energy from the sun.
cards.stem: Which process lets plants turn carbon dioxide and water into food using sunlight

cards.hint: Remember what powers life where sun never reaches
cards.quote: organisms instead rely on primary production through a process called chemosynthesis, which runs on chemical energy.
cards.stem: What kind of energy runs primary production where sunlight is absent in the deep ocean

cards.hint: Think of the word for makers of food in food webs
cards.quote: Autotroph: Organisms that are able to make their own food from raw materials and energy, also known as producers.
cards.stem: Organisms that make their own food are also known by what other name
